_what: The words the sign-in pages' script may show: failed, unavailable, not_sent and email_needed from the sign-in words the pages were drawn with; key_made is the key page's own; the rest are the connect pages' (consent, device). `scopes` says in plain words what each OAuth scope lets an AI do (a scope not listed is shown as its own name). `passkey_errors` says how a passkey step ended, by step (sign-in, make, any) and the error code Better Auth's client gives, from old {{name}}'s src/passkey-step.json: `already` means the device already holds a passkey, which is done.
failed: That did not work. Try again.
unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
not_sent: The code could not be sent just now, so none is on its way. Try again in a minute.
email_needed: Type the email address you sign in with.
key_made: Your key is made and copied. Keep it now: it is shown only once.
code_wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code_expired: That code ran out. Start again on your device.

scopes.offline_access: Stay connected while you keep using it
scopes.wake:*: Turn your tools' timers and triggers on and off
scopes.sharing.*: Share what you choose and see what you share
scopes.secrets:*: Use the logins and keys you keep
scopes.grants:offer: Ask you to let a tool use something on your computer (you say yes with your passkey)
scopes.grants:read-offer: Read what a tool asked to use on your computer

code_wrong_login: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code_ran_out: That code ran out. Send a new one.
code_tries: Too many wrong tries for that code. Send a new one.
link_sent: A link is on its way to your email. Open it on the other device.
email_change_sent: Two links are on their way: one to your current address to approve this, then one to the new address.
passkey_unknown: The passkey step did not finish. Please try again, or choose "Email me a code".

AUTH_CANCELLED.said: No passkey was used. Nothing changed.

ERROR_PASSTHROUGH_SEE_CAUSE_PROPERTY.said: No passkey was used. Nothing changed.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_PREVIOUSLY_REGISTERE.said: This device already has a passkey for {{name}}.

ERROR_CEREMONY_ABORTED.said: The passkey step was closed or timed out before a passkey was made. Nothing changed. You can try again.
The passkey step stopped before it finished. Nothing changed. You can try again.

ERROR_INVALID_RP_ID.said: This browser refused a passkey for this address. Open the address you normally use for {{name}} and try again.

ERROR_INVALID_DOMAIN.said: This browser refused a passkey for this address. Open the address you normally use for {{name}} and try again.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_NO_SUPPORTED_PUBKEYC.said: This browser cannot use passkeys. Choose "Email me a code" instead.

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_MISSING_DISCOVERABLE.said: This device cannot keep a passkey for {{name}}. Try your phone, or choose "Email me a code".

ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_MISSING_USER_VERIFIC.said: This device cannot keep a passkey for {{name}}. Try your phone, or choose "Email me a code".

ERROR_PASSTHROUGH_SEE_CAUSE_PROPERTY.said: Your device refused the passkey. Passkeys live in your Apple ID or password manager: open its settings, sign in, then try again, or choose "Email me a code".

connected_limit_none: Access never ends unless you end it.
connected_limit_label: End access after this many days unused
connected_reconnect_none: Open this AI and connect it again.

password_errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: That email and password do not match.
password_errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: This email is not confirmed yet. Email yourself a code to confirm it.
